title: Embed Dropped Files Into File Kit Json
description: When working in a file kit (JsonFileKitStore backed by *.kit.compose.json), files dropped into the kit or type apps must be embedded in the JSON file as data URLs on file.blob. Everything must stay fully inside the json file so reopening the kit restores blobs without external storage.
summary: Embedded dropped files into file-kit JSON by fixing a save/apply race. Root cause: JsonFileKitStore.embedFileBlob awaits blob.arrayBuffer() which yields the event loop. The 300ms auto-save scheduled after the addFile diff fires during that await, save() serializes the pre-embed kit, awaits adapter.write, then clobbers dirty=false after adapter.write resolves — losing the embed apply that ran mid-save. Fix: JsonFileKitStore.save captures `savedKit = this.kit` at start and only clears dirty when `this.kit === savedKit`; any interleaved apply keeps dirty=true so the next auto-save re-runs with the embedded blob. Also kept from prior session: embedFileBlob data-URL encoding, CollaborativeKitStore.embedFileBlob forwarder, uploadKitFileToProvider duck-typed unwrap, and applyFileDiff blob/description merge fix. Added two new regression tests in the JsonFileKitStore vitest block: "addFile diff followed by embedFileBlob embeds the blob on the newly added file" exercises the full diff-then-embed flow, and "save preserves dirty flag when an apply interleaves with an in-flight adapter.write" pins the race fix by gating adapter.write behind a resolver while embedFileBlob runs. All 201 js tests pass.
